balanceOfBatch(address[],uint256[]).details: See {IERC1155-balanceOfBatch}. Requirements: - `accounts` and `ids` must have the same length.

params.admin: The admin address granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE.
params.cityRegistry_: The ERC721 registry address for city ownership checks.
params.districtRegistry_: The ERC721 registry address for district ownership checks.
params.treasury_: The treasury address that receives treasury share and fallback platform fee.
params.usdc_: The USDC ERC20 token address used for payments.

params.cityId: The city identifier (used directly only for city-level passes).
params.districtId: The district identifier (0 for city-level pass).
params.durationDays: Duration in days for temporary passes (ignored for permanent passes).
params.maxSupply: Maximum mintable supply for this pass type.
params.passKind: 0 for permanent pass, 1 for temporary pass.
params.priceUsdc: Price per pass in USDC smallest units.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: True if holder has balance and pass is permanent or unexpired.
Expiry timestamp, type(uint256).max for permanent passes, or 0 if holder has no balance.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.newRevenueSplitter: The new revenue splitter address (zero address disables splitter and sends fee to treasury).

uri(uint256).details: See {IERC1155MetadataURI-uri}. This implementation returns the same URI for *all* token types. It relies on the token type ID substitution mechanism https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1155#metadata[defined in the ERC]. Clients calling this function must replace the `\{id\}` substring with the actual token type ID.

createPassType(uint256,uint256,uint8,uin.notice: Creates a pass type for a city or district.

hasValidPass(address,uint256).notice: Checks whether a holder currently has a valid pass.

mintPass(uint256,uint256).notice: Mints one or more passes for an active pass type.

passExpiry(address,uint256).notice: Returns the expiry timestamp for a holder's pass type.

setCityRegistry(address).notice: Sets the city registry contract used for city ownership authorization.

setDistrictRegistry(address).notice: Sets the district registry contract used for district ownership authorization.

setPassTypeActive(uint256,bool).notice: Enables or disables an existing pass type.

setRevenueSplitter(address).notice: Sets the revenue splitter address used for platform fee handling.

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: Returns whether an interface is supported.
